evidence_config.how_to_read: Use this dashboard to avoid weak/risky setups first, then prioritize manual research. Do not treat high score as a buy signal. A clean distribution-risk profile is useful, but still not enough for automatic buying.

benchmark_context.analysis_window: 2017-05-18 to 2026-05-27 (stock universe); portfolio sim up to 719 weekly rebalance steps (U1_TOP_200_ADV50)
benchmark_context.vnindex_caveat: VNINDEX cap-weight may be Vingroup-skewed; do not treat as sole benchmark for broad liquid stocks.
benchmark_context.primary_benchmark_note: Prefer equal-weight liquid-universe context over VNINDEX alone when judging broad-market conditions.
benchmark_context.v4_variant_note: V4_NO_DISTRIBUTION_RISK is a research-only risk filter, not production alpha.
